Review this pull request as an independent engineering reviewer.

Follow applicable `AGENTS.md` Code Review Rules.
Prioritize correctness, regressions, security boundaries, data loss, race conditions, and missing tests.
Do not report formatting or style preferences that deterministic tooling can handle.
For each finding, include severity, evidence, affected file, and a concise remediation direction.
If no consequential finding is supported by the diff, say so.
